The '''Theater District''' was a district of the [[Kaon City]] on [[Kaon]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak]] in [[3639 BBY]] the district was overrun by [[Rakghoul]]s, who attacked the strike team making their way to the [[Kaon City Spaceport]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Theater District appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Kaon Under Siege" flashpoint.
